params.body:
The site stopped showing "Zo verloopt het" on the services and the three steps on "Voertuig verkopen" with #8 / site #45. The `steps` fields stayed in the schema, hidden and without rules, so the data already written would not be flagged in the Studio.

That data is now cleared in `o1i7w9ht/production` (6 documents, 18 steps, backed up first), so the fields can go:

- `service.steps` and `sellPage.steps` removed from the schema
- the contract test, CONTRACT.md and README follow
- `contentItem` is now described as a paragraph or fact

The site does not read `steps`, so it needs no change.

Checked locally: vitest (16), tsc, eslint and `sanity build`.

After merge: deploy the Studio (`npm run deploy` with a Deploy Studio token).
params.title: Remove the old steps fields from service and sellPage
